Clean ROM: a distinct instruction stream follows FUN_8000C6B0's jr ra/nop at 0x8000C6D0/0x8000C6D4; this entry begins at 0x8000C6D8 (ROM 0xD2D8) and saves ra at 0x8000C6EC. Ghidra may leave this indirect callback entry undefined; disassemble/verify the body before creating its function.
